_network_type: Nested leave-one-speaker-out (LOSO/LOGO) comparative: NSGA-II-searched SNN-AE (encoder depth/width, encoding, architecture, v_th, alpha all genes) vs LSTM-AE / GRU-AE / Transformer-AE baselines, one OS process per (dataset, outer fold).
_architecture_summary: SNN-AE: free encoder_widths genome (strictly decreasing, decoder mirrors encoder), exponential surrogate; R, C, V_th learnable, clamped 1e-6. Baselines match article-lstm-ae (H=64, latent 32; GRU/Transformer analogues). The driver runs NSGA-II (population x (1+generations) evaluations) over the SNN-AE's own architecture, encoding, and biophysical params, selects the winning genome from the rank-0 Pareto front on the inner validation speaker, retrains it on train+val (early-stopping on a recording-disjoint monitor carved from train), and evaluates once on the held-out test speaker. GA is the only SNN architecture search mechanism -- no grid/sweep path exists.
_preprocessing: Non-overlapping 256-sample windows (32 ms @ 8 kHz for FSDD / AudioMNIST; 360 Hz for MIT-BIH). Per-window z-score, then spike encoding over model.time_steps = 16 REAL simulation steps -> a (16, 256) time-major tensor (row = t*B + b). Encoding (direct/poisson/latency) is a GA gene, not an outer sweep. Every model -- SNN and the three baselines alike -- is trained to reconstruct the ORIGINAL z-scored window (repeated across the 16 steps), never its own spike code, so val_mse is comparable across encodings. Stratified per-fold window caps (loso_max_{train,val,test}_windows = 200 / 150 / 1500) round-robin across recording_id so every speaker/recording stays represented; LOSO structure and the recording-level statistical unit are unchanged.
_total_runs_breakdown: Per (dataset, fold): 3 baselines x 3 encodings x 5 seeds + population(8) x (1 + generations(5)) = 48 GA-searched SNN trainings x 5 seeds + |Pareto front| x (winner_seeds(3) - 1) re-scorings x 5 seeds + 1 retrained winner. x 3 datasets x 6 folds. Weeks on CPU. The train/val window caps were cut (1200 -> 200, 300 -> 150) and the GA budget reduced (90 -> 48 evaluations) to pay for the 16x cost of real temporal simulation; the test cap stays at 1500 because evaluation is forward-only and those windows are what the recording-level statistics are computed over.
_dataset_config: Speaker/record-disjoint outer folds (6). No pooled sample caps (max_loaded_train_samples / max_validation_samples = 0 -> every window of the disjoint partitions, then the stratified loso_max_* caps apply). 30 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001 (weights) / 0.0001 (R, C, V_th), batch size 1. Per-epoch progress on stderr as '[loso] ... epoch N/M' (survives nohup, where the live bars collapse).
_comment: Nested-LOSO comparative for the meeting01 paper revision. Run once via scripts/pipeline/meeting01/01_meeting01_run_loso.sh (ONE invocation; ~weeks). cv_fold here is a default; the run script overrides it per process with --cv-fold.
